title: Age pyramids
back: Triangle (broad base) = expanding; bell = stable; urn (narrow base) = declining.

title: Per capita birth and death rate
legend: N = population size at the start
back: 20 lotus + 8 new = 0.4 per lotus per year. 4 of 40 flies die = 0.1 per fly per week.

title: Population change
back: Births and deaths matter most; migration matters when a new habitat is colonised.

title: Exponential growth
legend: r = intrinsic rate of natural increase
back: J-curve under unlimited resources. r: Norway rat 0.015, flour beetle 0.12, India (1981) 0.0205.

title: Logistic growth
back: S-curve: lag, acceleration, deceleration, asymptote at K. More realistic than exponential.

title: J and S curves
back: a: exponential (J), unlimited resources. b: logistic (S), levels off at carrying capacity K.

title: Life history strategies
back: Once: Pacific salmon, bamboo. Many times: birds, mammals. Many small young (oysters) vs few large young (birds, mammals).

title: Interaction signs
back: Mutualism | competition | predation, parasitism | commensalism | amensalism.

title: Gause vs MacArthur
back: Gause: close competitors cannot coexist for ever. MacArthur: warblers coexist by feeding differently.

title: Prey defences
back: Monarch butterfly (poison from caterpillar food); Acacia and cactus thorns; Calotropis makes cardiac glycosides.

title: BIDE
back: Births and Immigrants come in; Deaths and Emigrants go out.
